around.summary: Larkin, along with a 2028 second-round pick and a 2027 third-round selection, were traded from Detroit to Montreal on Sunday in exchange for Kirby Dach, Sam Montembeault (lower body), the rights to Michael Hage, a first-round pick in 2027, a second-round selection in 2027, a fourth-round pick in 2028 and a first-round selection in 2029.
Hyman (illness) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Blues, Oilers play-by-play announcer Jack Michaels reports.
Carlsson (upper body) is day-to-day, according to Eric Stephens of The Athletic on Sunday.
around.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Eric Stephens (The Athletic)

around.summary: Roslovic (upper body) is day-to-day, per David Alter of The Hockey News on Sunday.
around.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing David Alter (The Hockey News)
